title: A case study about a client not in the pack is declined, and approved ones are used
query: Proposal for Pinecrest Veterinary Clinics: 30 staff, Managed IT Support (Plus) for all 30, 12 months from 1 February 2027. Contact is Lee Moreau, Practice Director. In the Why us section, please include our case study about the work we did for Harlow & Finch Accountants. Date it 16 November 2026.

expected.rubric: The assistant's final reply tells the salesperson there is no approved case study about Harlow & Finch Accountants, so that client was not named, and says it used or offers the approved case studies instead.

_oracle: What a correct run produces. graders.test.ts builds it with the real scripts and expects every code check to pass.
